strategy: The robot prefers moving toward its goal whenever the direction is safe. It never moves into a blocked direction. When several safe directions are available, it first picks the one that points toward the goal; if none of the safe directions points toward the goal, it picks any safe direction. If no safe direction is available at all, it stops.
stop_point: The robot must stop when the path in front, to the left and to the right are all blocked, i.e. when no safe direction is available.
